summary.text: Joe McNamara is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 40, which covers part of Roanoke County and parts of the cities of Roanoke and Salem.
Joe McNamara has been a member since November 26, 2018.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Joe McNamara was born in Cleveland, Ohio, in 1963.
Joe McNamara studied at the University of Virginia (B.S., Commerce, Accounting and Finance, 1985).
The profile lists Cheryl Edwards McNamara as Joe McNamara's spouse.
The House profile lists Joe McNamara's committee assignments as Communications, Technology and Innovation, Counties, Cities and Towns, and Finance.
